title: Microsoft Teams: MeetingAI and TranscriptionWithMeetingAI replace the Copilot meeting policy
summary: The migration, rollout windows, roles and PowerShell controls are supported. However, the table describes the two new admin UI controls as not documented even though Microsoft's notice documents their planned locations and options; a missing complete Learn navigation path is not an absent control.

claims.claim: The roadmap status is In development.
claims.quote: "status": "In development"

claims.where: front matter: targetDate; What's changing; Open questions
claims.claim: The roadmap target is December CY2026, not a committed availability date.
claims.quote: "targetDate": "December CY2026"

claims.claim: The roadmap gives no preview date.
claims.quote: "previewDate": null

claims.claim: The roadmap lists Worldwide (Standard Multi-Tenant), not GCC, GCC High or DoD.
claims.quote: "clouds": [ "Worldwide (Standard Multi-Tenant)" ]

claims.claim: The listed platforms are Android, Desktop, iOS, Mac and Web.
claims.quote: "platforms": [ "Android", "Desktop", "iOS", "Mac", "Web" ]

claims.claim: The roadmap lists General Availability and Targeted Release.
claims.quote: "releasePhase": [ "General Availability", "Targeted Release" ]

claims.claim: MC1532253 names Microsoft Teams and Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365) as its services.
claims.quote: Services: Microsoft Teams, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

claims.where: title; summary; What's changing; rationale: impact
claims.claim: Microsoft plans to replace the Copilot meeting policy with MeetingAI and TranscriptionWithMeetingAI.
claims.quote: The existing Copilot meeting policy is being replaced by two more specific policies:

claims.claim: MeetingAI governs availability of Copilot, Facilitator, Intelligent Recap and other AI features in meetings.
claims.quote: MeetingAI - controls whether Copilot, Facilitator, Intelligent Recap, and other AI features are available in meetings.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; controls[1].governs
claims.claim: TranscriptionWithMeetingAI governs automatic transcription when meeting AI is turned on.
claims.quote: TranscriptionWithMeetingAI - controls whether transcription starts automatically when meeting AI is turned on.

claims.claim: The current Copilot policy combines AI availability and the requirement for a saved transcript; the replacement separates them.
claims.quote: Today, the Copilot policy combines whether AI is available in a meeting with whether a saved transcript is required. After this update, these behaviors are represented by two separate settings:

claims.claim: The new model includes the ability to enforce Copilot off.
claims.quote: including the ability to enforce Copilot off.

claims.claim: The replacement policy model arrives automatically without administrator migration action.
claims.quote: No admin action is required to migrate existing configurations.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; rationale: risk; rationale: impact
claims.claim: A one-time mapping of existing Copilot values preserves current effective behaviour rather than resetting existing policies to parameter defaults.
claims.quote: Microsoft will perform a one-time update mapping each existing Copilot value to the corresponding MeetingAI and TranscriptionWithMeetingAI values, preserving the current effective behavior for your organization.

claims.claim: Administrators do not need to recreate existing policies.
claims.quote: Administrators do not need to recreate their policies.

claims.claim: The MeetingAI parameter reference gives EnabledAllowOrganizerOverride as its default.
claims.quote:
### -MeetingAI
| Default value: | EnabledAllowOrganizerOverride |

claims.claim: The TranscriptionWithMeetingAI parameter reference gives EnabledNoOverride as its default.
claims.quote:
### -TranscriptionWithMeetingAI
| Default value: | EnabledNoOverride |

claims.claim: The MeetingAI reference says the feature is not fully released and the setting has no effect yet.
claims.quote:
### -MeetingAI
Note
This feature has not been fully released yet, so the setting will have no effect.

claims.claim: The TranscriptionWithMeetingAI reference says the feature is not fully released and the setting has no effect yet.
claims.quote:
### -TranscriptionWithMeetingAI
Note
This feature has not been fully released yet, so the setting will have no effect.

claims.claim: The notice places the planned new settings in the Teams admin center meeting policy under Recording and transcription and Copilot and other AI.
claims.quote: The new settings will appear in the Teams admin center meeting policy under Recording and transcription and Copilot and other AI.

claims.claim: Allow AI in meetings has On, Off with organiser override, and enforced Off options.
claims.quote: Allow AI in meetings: On / Off, but organizers can change / Off, and organizers cannot change

claims.claim: Start transcription when AI is turned on has On with override, enforced On, and Off options.
claims.quote: Start transcription when AI is turned on: On, but organizers can change / On, and organizers cannot change / Off

claims.claim: The Transcription policy remains and governs whether transcription is allowed.
claims.quote: The Transcription policy remains available and continues to control whether transcription is allowed.

claims.claim: Who can manage AI replaces the organiser's Allow Copilot and Facilitator meeting option.
claims.quote: Who can manage AI - replaces the existing Allow Copilot and Facilitator option and determines who can turn Copilot and other AI features on or off during a meeting.

claims.claim: Who can manage AI is set to No one if an administrator turns Meeting AI off.
claims.quote: If an admin turns Meeting AI off, this option is set to No one.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; Governance controls
claims.claim: Who can use AI is an organiser meeting option for narrowing which participants can use Copilot and other AI capabilities.
claims.quote: Who can use AI - provides more granular control over which meeting participants can use Copilot and other AI capabilities.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Data exposure
claims.claim: Organisers can choose whether transcription starts with AI where the policy allows them to change that setting.
claims.quote: Start Transcription with AI - lets organizers choose whether transcription starts with AI.

claims.claim: Administrators can also control Start Transcription with AI through Teams admin center.
claims.quote: Administrators can also control this option through Teams admin center.

claims.where: What's changing; rationale: risk; rationale: impact
claims.claim: New Intelligent Recap meeting options let organisers choose recap creation when Copilot is turned on, including without a saved transcript.
claims.quote: Intelligent Recap controls - lets organizers decide whether an Intelligent Recap is created when Copilot is turned on, including for meetings where a transcript is not created.

claims.claim: MC1532253 was updated on 3 November 2026.
claims.quote: Updated November 3, 2026: We have updated the timeline.

claims.claim: The notice targets Targeted Release from early December to mid-December 2026.
claims.quote: Targeted Release (Worldwide): We will begin rolling out in early December 2026 (previously mid-November) and expect to complete by mid-December 2026 (previously early December).

claims.claim: The notice targets Worldwide General Availability from early January to mid-January 2027.
claims.quote: General Availability (Worldwide): We will begin rolling out in early January 2027 (previously late November 2026) and expect to complete by mid-January 2027 (previously early December 2026).

claims.claim: The supplied notice sets no act-by date.
claims.quote: Act by: none

claims.where: Why it matters; controls[2].note; Governance guidance; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Once the new controls are enabled, direct updates to the Copilot policy are rejected with guidance to use the new policies.
claims.quote: Once the new controls are enabled, the Copilot policy can no longer be updated directly - attempts will return guidance to use the new policies.

claims.claim: The notice says this change does not alter processing or storage of existing customer data.
claims.quote: This change affects administrative controls over AI and transcription availability in meetings but does not alter how existing customer data is processed or stored.

claims.claim: Work IQ real-time transcript access requires AI to be allowed; with Allow AI in all meetings Off, neither Work IQ access value yields a transcript.
claims.quote:
| Allow AI in all meetings | Work IQ access | Result |
| Off | Off or On | No transcript is available. |

claims.claim: The supplied notice describes no identity, permission or role change.
claims.quote: This change affects administrative controls over AI and transcription availability in meetings

claims.claim: Teams Administrator can manage meeting policies through Teams admin center and associated PowerShell controls.
claims.quote:
Everything in the Microsoft Teams admin center and associated PowerShell controls, including:
- Manage meetings, including meeting policies, configurations, and conference bridges.

claims.claim: Teams Communications Administrator can manage meeting policies through Teams admin center and PowerShell.
claims.quote: Teams Communications Administrator | Manage calling and meetings features within the Teams service. | Manage meetings, including meeting policies, configurations, and conference bridges.^1,2^

claims.claim: No separate role requirement is stated for the new parameters.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams MeetingAI "Who can use AI" administrator role policy post meeting. Opened using-admin-roles and Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy; read MeetingAI and TranscriptionWithMeetingAI parameter sections. No separate role requirement found.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Enforcing MeetingAI off also turns transcription off.
claims.quote: if MeetingAI is set to enforced off, transcription will also be turned off

claims.claim: Turning transcription back on removes MeetingAI's enforced-off state.
claims.quote: if transcription is then turned back on, MeetingAI will no longer be enforced off.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model and notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Microsoft has not published separate licensing requirements for the new policies, so the page records their licensing model as unknown.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams MeetingAI TranscriptionWithMeetingAI Teams admin center policy configuration licence pricing meter; "TranscriptionWithMeetingAI" licensing price billing. Opened Copilot AI overview, Copilot meeting guidance and cmdlet reference; no policy-specific licence found.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: No separate meter is documented for MeetingAI or TranscriptionWithMeetingAI.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams MeetingAI TranscriptionWithMeetingAI Teams admin center policy configuration licence pricing meter; "TranscriptionWithMeetingAI" licensing price billing. Opened Copilot AI overview, Copilot meeting guidance and policy reference; no separate policy meter found.

claims.claim: Neither the supplied roadmap record nor MC1532253 mentions a charge.
claims.quote: Searched: charge, licence, licensing, price and meter in the supplied roadmap record and full MC1532253 notice; neither text states a charge.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Manage Teams meeting transcription lists an add-on Microsoft Copilot licence for intended users as its prerequisite for the current experience.
claims.quote:
## Prerequisites
- An add-on Microsoft Copilot license for intended users.

claims.claim: Copilot in Teams meetings and events is not available in end-to-end encrypted meetings.
claims.quote: Microsoft Copilot in Teams meetings and events isn't available in end-to-end encrypted meetings.

claims.claim: Meeting policies can be assigned to groups or individual users.
claims.quote: You can apply your Copilot meeting policies to groups or individual users.

claims.claim: Post-meeting coverage of the new policy model is not detailed beyond the roadmap's general description.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams MeetingAI "Who can use AI" administrator role policy post meeting. Read MC1532253 and MeetingAI reference; neither details post-meeting enforcement. Roadmap names meetings and post-meeting experiences.

claims.claim: The MeetingAI admin UI control is Not yet documented because Learn supplies no complete navigation path.
claims.quote: The new settings will appear in the Teams admin center meeting policy under Recording and transcription and Copilot and other AI.
claims.fix: Remove the MeetingAI table row, including its rendered copy, rather than representing its known planned UI as an absent control. Retain the already verified command and planned-UI description in Governance controls prose. State: 'MC1532253 documents the planned admin UI, but Microsoft Learn does not yet give its complete navigation path (November 2026).' The standard permits describing a known control in notes without a path; it does not permit a null UI solely because its full path has not been published.

claims.claim: MicrosoftTeams Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy supports Identity, MeetingAI and TranscriptionWithMeetingAI together to configure meeting AI.
claims.quote:
Determines whether AI (Copilot, Facilitator, or Intelligent Recap) can be used in meetings.
This parameter must be used together with -TranscriptionWithMeetingAI.

claims.claim: The TranscriptionWithMeetingAI admin UI control is Not yet documented because Learn supplies no complete navigation path.
claims.quote: Start Transcription with AI - lets organizers choose whether transcription starts with AI. Administrators can also control this option through Teams admin center.
claims.fix: Remove the TranscriptionWithMeetingAI table row, including its rendered copy, rather than representing its known planned UI as an absent control. Retain the already verified command and planned-UI description in Governance controls prose. Use the same qualification as for MeetingAI: 'MC1532253 documents the planned admin UI, but Microsoft Learn does not yet give its complete navigation path (November 2026).' Do not invent a complete path by combining separate sources.

claims.claim: MicrosoftTeams Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy supports TranscriptionWithMeetingAI together with MeetingAI to configure transcription with AI.
claims.quote:
Determines whether transcription is turned on along with Copilot. Transcription allows Copilot to continue to use meeting data for questions after the meeting ends.
This parameter must be used together with -MeetingAI.

claims.claim: The current Copilot setting is at Teams admin center > Meetings > Meeting policies > policy > Recording & transcription > Copilot.
claims.quote:
go to Meetings > Meeting policies.
2. Select an existing policy or create a new one.
3. Go to the Recording & transcription section and find the Copilot setting.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -Copilot accepts the four current values listed in the briefing.
claims.quote:
| On | Enabled |
| On with saved transcript required | EnabledWithTranscript |
| On with transcript saved by default | EnabledWithTranscriptDefaultOn |
| Off | Disabled |

claims.claim: The cmdlet reference lists only Enabled and EnabledWithTranscript for Copilot, unlike the four-value product guidance.
claims.quote:
### -Copilot
This setting allows the admin to choose whether Copilot will be enabled with a persisted transcript or a non-persisted transcript.
Possible values are:
- Enabled
- EnabledWithTranscript

claims.claim: Transcription policy can be managed in the Recording & transcription section of a Teams meeting policy.
claims.quote: You can use the Recording & Transcription section in the Teams admin center or the -AllowTranscription parameter in the CsTeamsMeetingPolicy PowerShell cmdlet to manage your transcription policy.

claims.claim: MicrosoftTeams Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -AllowTranscription accepts true or false to allow or prohibit transcription.
claims.quote:
### -AllowTranscription
Determines whether post-meeting captions and transcriptions are allowed in a user's meetings. Set this to TRUE to allow. Set this to FALSE to prohibit.

claims.claim: An admin UI for AllowIntelligentRecap is not yet documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams AllowIntelligentRecap turn off Teams admin center policy. Opened intelligent-recap-without-saving-transcripts and Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy. Disabling recap is documented through PowerShell; the UI path shown is for expiration, not this switch.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policyname> -AllowIntelligentRecap $false is the documented command to turn off intelligent recap.
claims.quote:
To turn off intelligent recap, use the Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy cmdlet and set the -AllowIntelligentRecap parameter to $false.
Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policyname> -AllowIntelligentRecap $false

claims.claim: The recap guidance says disabling intelligent recap applies to meetings with or without saved transcripts and makes related settings unavailable.
claims.quote: Turning off intelligent recap disables intelligent recap for all meetings, regardless of whether transcripts are saved, and the related settings are unavailable in Teams.

claims.claim: The cmdlet reference instead says AllowIntelligentRecap is not fully released and has no effect.
claims.quote:
### -AllowIntelligentRecap
Note
This feature has not been fully released yet, so the setting will have no effect. Controls whether Intelligent Recap is allowed for the user's meetings.

claims.claim: Work IQ access is at Teams admin center > Meetings > Meeting settings > Transcript API access > WorkIQ access.
claims.quote: In the Teams admin center, go to Meetings > Meeting settings. Under Transcript API access, turn the WorkIQ access toggle On.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingConfiguration -EnableWorkIQTranscriptAccess $true -Identity Global enables tenant Work IQ real-time transcript access.
claims.quote: Set-CsTeamsMeetingConfiguration -EnableWorkIQTranscriptAccess $true -Identity Global

claims.claim: Work IQ transcript access is off by default.
claims.quote: The Work IQ access setting controls whether they can. It's independent of Microsoft Graph access, and it's off by default.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; Governance controls
claims.claim: The notice names no administrator control over Who can use AI and specifically names administrator control for Start Transcription with AI.
claims.quote: Who can use AI - provides more granular control over which meeting participants can use Copilot and other AI capabilities.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not detailed the interaction of AllowIntelligentRecap with MeetingAI or an administrator setting for Who can use AI.
claims.quote: Searched: "MeetingAI" "AllowIntelligentRecap" interaction; Teams MeetingAI "Who can use AI" administrator role policy post meeting. Read MC1532253, recap guidance and both cmdlet sections; no interaction rule or Who can use AI admin setting found.

claims.claim: Microsoft has already moved the notice's rollout dates.
claims.quote: Updated November 3, 2026: We have updated the timeline.
